newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar prices firm, more seasonal demand seen.
newsitem.headline: India sugar prices firm, more seasonal demand seen.

text.p: Indian sugar prices firmed on Friday in narrow trade and on expectations of demand rising for the festival season, dealers said.
They said the low consumer demand lifted prices. "Millers are expecting more demand in the next few days for various festivals and are holding back stock," one dealer said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was quoted at 1,355/1,388 rupees while M-30 was steady at 1,385/1,438 rupees. Sugar mill delivery was unchanged at 1,295/1,305 rupees.
The markets were closed on Thursday for a Hindu festival.
